previous_hypothesis_updates.reason: Diarylnitro compounds repeatedly exceeded their frozen centers.
Silicon probes repeatedly showed substantial negative signed errors.
Lower IPA increased measured RTv more than predicted.
Chloro and fluoro pyrrolidines exceeded centers across labels.
Pyrimidyl compounds exceeded aryl controls in both comparisons.
Observed stereochemical ordering varied across scaffolds.
Both ortho-methoxy diarylnitro candidates were overpredicted.
Negative parent and fluoro errors contrasted with positive bromo errors.
The opposite alcohol showed a larger-than-predicted IPA response.
Post-retraining silicon probes retained substantial residuals.
Hydrocarbon and cyanoester stereochemical gaps collapsed or reversed.
The parent pair retained a smaller, reversed stereochemical gap.
The opposite pyrimidyl compound still exceeded its aryl control.
Nitro residuals varied with position, halogenation, and configuration.
Fluorinated thioether residuals were mostly positive but not uniform.
The para-chloro alcohol showed a much larger IPA response.
Chain labels showed mixed residuals without a monotonic trend.
Acid and ester responses stayed close despite predicted separation.
Matched fluoro labels had large residuals but a small stereo gap.
Several non-silicon low-center enols exceeded their centers.
New nitro labels showed strong substitution-dependent residual magnitude.
Methoxy thioether labels had opposing residual directions.
Short and long chains remained near-centered without monotonic transfer.
Substituted cyclic ureas were generally underpredicted.
Most low-center enols were underpredicted, with one positive residual.
New sulfonyl pyrrolidines consistently fell below centers.
New stereopairs showed smaller, scaffold-dependent ordering differences.
Distant oxygenated topologies showed mixed, substantial residuals.

response.feedback_interpretation: Historical residuals remain local and scaffold dependent. Nitro, thioether, stereochemical, and enol transfer directions are mixed; cyclic urea and sulfonyl families show clearer substitution-linked residuals. IPA effects transfer more consistently. Centers are MSE point predictions, widths are uncalibrated, and coverage is a raw-gradient distance percentile.
response.batch_rationale: The batch globally combines matched nitro and thioether constitutional controls, cyclic-urea substitutions, low-center enol variants, sulfonyl-pyrrolidine probes, stereochemical arbitration pairs, silicon topology controls, and distant donor-rich or fused topologies. Selection emphasizes contradiction resolution and redundant controls across conditions.
